title: Enable 640G as full data source via 640G Uploader application to allow Sync following to work correctly
symptom: Users with a Medtronic 640G/Enlite want xDrip to include the Nightscout Medtronic/600SeriesAndroidUploader as a data source in master mode, so readings can be sent directly to xDrip followers and smartwatches with audible alarms. The Medtronic 640G's own alarms are quiet or not perceived, making xDrip's loud alarms desirable.
cause: xDrip did not have the Medtronic 600SeriesAndroidUploader/uploader integrated as a source, so it could receive data only in follower mode, not master mode, preventing direct forwarding to followers.
fix: Developer jamorham implemented the 640G uploader as a source in xDrip and released it in the 21 Aug version; the issue was then closed.
evidence_quote: Okay, I believe the request that this issue ticket relates to is now resolved. I will mark it closed.
